title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 11 章‧各處所的潔淨
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura mazda
... ashâum kutha nmânem ýaozhdathâni
kutha âtrem kutha âpem kutha zãm kutha gãm
kutha urvarãm kutha narem ashavanem kutha nâirikãm
ashaonîm kutha strêsh kutha månghem kutha hvare
kutha anakhra raocå kutha vîspa vohu mazdadhâta
ashacithra.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda! most beneficent
spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How shall
I cleanse the house? how the fire? how the water? how the earth?
how the cow? how the tree? how the faithful man and the faithful
woman : how the stars? how the moon? how the sun? how the boundless
light? how all good things, made by Mazda, the offspring of the
holy principle?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達！最仁慈的靈啊，物質世界的造主，持阿沙的聖者啊！我應如何潔淨房舍？如何潔淨火？如何潔淨水？如何潔淨土？如何潔淨牛？如何潔淨樹？如何潔淨信心的男人與信心的女人？如何潔淨星辰？如何潔淨月亮？如何潔淨太陽？如何潔淨無邊的光？如何潔淨所有由馬茲達造成的善物，聖德的後裔？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýaozhdâthrem
srâvayôish zarathushtra ýaozhdâta pascaêta
bun nmâna ýaozhdâta âtrem ýaozhdâta
âpem ýaozhdâta zãm ýaozhdâta
gãm ýaozhdâta urvarãm ýaozhdâta
narem ashavanem ýaozhdâta nâirikãm ashaonîm
ýaozhdâta strêsh ýaozhdâta månghem
ýaozhdâta hvare ýaozhdâta anakhra raocå
ýaozhdâta vîspa vohu mazdadhâta ashacithra.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thou shalt chant the cleansing words,
and the house shall be clean; clean shall be the fire, clean the
water, clean the earth, clean the cow, clean the tree, clean the
faithful man and the faithful woman, clean the stars, clean the
moon, clean the sun, clean the boundless light, clean all good
things, made by Mazda, the offspring of the holy principle.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「汝應誦唱潔淨之言，則房舍潔淨；火潔淨，水潔淨，土潔淨，牛潔淨，樹潔淨，信心的男人與信心的女人潔淨，星辰潔淨，月亮潔淨，太陽潔淨，無邊的光潔淨，所有由馬茲達造成的善物，聖德的後裔，皆潔淨。

segments.orig:
atha imã vacô dreñjayôish ýôi
anghen vârethrakhnyôtememca baêshazyôtememca
pañca ahuna vairya frasrâvayôish, ýathâ
ahû vairyô...(5), ahunem vairîm tanûm
pâiti, ýathâ ahû vairyô ... kêm-nâ
mazdâ ... ashahe.
segments.en:
['So thou shalt say these victorious, most healing words];
thou shalt chant the Ahuna-Vairya five times: "The will of
the Lord is the law of righteousness," &c.
'The Ahuna-Vairya preserves the person of man:
'" Yatha ahu vairyo : - The will of the Lord is the law of
righteousness," &c.
'" Kem-na mazda : - What protector hast thou given unto me,
O Mazda! while the hate of the wicked encompasses me?" &c.
'"Ke verethrem-ja: - Who is the victorious who will protect
thy teaching?" &c.
'"Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Armaiti Spenta!"
&c.1
segments.zh: 【汝應誦唱這些勝利的、最具癒力的言詞】；汝應誦唱《阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞》五次：「主的意志乃是正義之法，」等等。《阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞》守護人的身體：「『雅塔 阿胡 瓦伊里歐：主的意志乃是正義之法，』等等。『『凱姆‧那 馬茲達：噢馬茲達，汝給了我何種保護者，當惡人的恨惡包圍我時？』等等。『『凱 瓦雷瑟倫-加：誰是勝利者，誰將守護汝的教導？』等等。『願馬茲達與斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提守護我們免於仇恨者！』等等。

segments.orig:
imat nmânem ýaozhdathâne imã adha
vacô framrva, at mâ ýavâ beñdvô
pafre mazishtô, imat âtrem ýaozhdathâne
imã adha vacô framrva, ahe thwâ âthrô
verezâna paoirye pairijasâmaide mazda ahurâ.
segments.en:
'If thou wantest to cleanse the house, say these words aloud:
"As long as the sickness lasts my great protector [is he
who teaches virtue to the perverse]."
'If thou wantest to cleanse the fire, say these words aloud: "Thy
fire, first of all, do we approach with worship, O Ahura Mazda!"
segments.zh: 「若汝欲潔淨房舍，當大聲誦唱這些言詞：『只要病痛持續，我偉大的保護者【就是他，教導反抗者向善】。』「若汝欲潔淨火，當大聲誦唱這些言詞：『汝的火，首先，我們以虔敬之心親近，噢阿胡拉‧馬茲達！』」

segments.orig:
imat âpem ýaozhdathâne imã adha
vacô framrva, apô at ýazamaide maêkaiñtîshcâ
hêbvañtîshcâ fravazanghô, imat
zãm ýaozhdathâne imã adha vacô
framrva, imãm âat zãm genâbîsh
hathrâ ýazamaide.
segments.en:
'If thou wantest to cleanse the water, say these words aloud:
" Waters we worship, the Maekainti waters, the Hebvainti
waters, the Fravazah waters."
'If thou wantest to cleanse the earth, say these words aloud:
"This earth we worship, this earth with the women, this earth
which bears us and those women who are thine, O Ahura!"
segments.zh: 「若汝欲潔淨水，當大聲誦唱這些言詞：『我們禮拜眾水，美艾凱提之水，赫布瓦提之水，弗拉瓦札之水。』「若汝欲潔淨土，當大聲誦唱這些言詞：『我們禮拜此土，我們禮拜此土與女性，我們禮拜撫育我們與汝的那些女性的此土，噢阿胡拉！』」

segments.orig:
imãm gãm ýaozhdathâne imã
adha vacô framrva, gave adhâish tâish shyaothnâish
ýâish vahishtâish fraêshyâmahî,
imat urvarãm ýaozhdathâne imã adha
vacô framrva, at ah'yâi ashâ mazdå urvarå
vaxshat.
segments.en:
'If thou wantest to cleanse the cow, say these words aloud:
"The best of all works we will fulfil while we order both
the learned and the unlearned, both masters and servants to secure
for the cattle a good resting-place and fodder."
'If thou wantest to cleanse the trees, say these words aloud:
"For him, as a reward, Mazda made the plants
grow up."
segments.zh: 「若汝欲潔淨牛，當大聲誦唱這些言詞：『所有工作中最好的，我們將完成，當我們命令既學識淵博者亦庸人，既主人亦僕人為牲畜保證一個良好的棲息所與飼料。』「若汝欲潔淨樹木，當大聲誦唱這些言詞：『作為報酬，馬茲達為他使植物生長。』」

segments.orig:
imat narem ashavanem ýaozhdathâne imat nâirikãm
ashaonîm ýaozhdathâne imã adha vacô
framrva, â airyêmâ ishyô rafedhrâi
jañtû nerebyascâ nâiribyascâ zarathushtrahe
vanghêush rafedhrâi mananghô ýâ
daênâ vairîm hanât mîzhdem ashahyâ
ýâsâ ashîm ýãm ishyãm
ahurô masatâ mazdå.
segments.en:
'If thou wantest to cleanse the faithful man or the faithful
woman, say these words aloud: "May the vow-fulfilling Airyaman
come hither, for the men and women of Zarathushtra to rejoice,
for Vohu-mano to rejoice; with the desirable reward that Religion
deserves. I solicit for holiness that boon that is vouchsafed
by Ahura!"
segments.zh: 「若汝欲潔淨信心的男人或信心的女人，當大聲誦唱這些言詞：『願誓言履行者艾里曼來此，為查拉圖斯特拉的男人與女人欣悅，為沃胡‧曼諾欣悅；以宗教應得的令人渴望的賞賜。我為聖性懇求阿胡拉所許可的那個福祉！』」

segments.orig:
atha imã vacô ... ashta ahuna vairya frasrâvayôish,
ýathâ ahû vairyô...(8). kêm-nâ
mazdâ ... ashahe.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt say these victorious, most healing words.
Thou shalt chant the Ahuna-Vairya eight times:-
'"Yatha ahu vairya:- The will of the Lord is the law of righteousness,"
&c.
'"Kem-na mazda:- Whom hast thou placed to protect me, O Mazda?"
&c.
'"Ke verethrem-ga:- What protector hast thou given unto me?"
&c.
'"Who is the victorious?" &c.
'"Keep us from our hater, O Mazda!" &c.
segments.zh: 「然後汝應誦唱這些勝利的、最具癒力的言詞。汝應誦唱《阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞》八次：『『雅塔 阿胡 瓦伊里歐：主的意志乃是正義之法，』等等。『『凱姆‧那 馬茲達：噢馬茲達，汝置何人於我的保護者之位？』等等。『『凱 瓦雷瑟倫-加：汝給了我何種保護者？』等等。『『誰是勝利者？』等等。『『願馬茲達守護我們免於仇恨者！』等等。

segments.orig:
perene aêshmem perene nasûm perene hãm-
raêthwem perene paiti-raêthwem perene xrû perene
xrvikhni perene bûidhi perene bûidhizha perene kuñdi
perene kuñdizha perene bûshyãsta ýâ
zairina perene bûshyãsta ýâ darekhô-gava
perene mûidhi perene kapastish perene pairikãm ýâ
âiti âtrem âpem zãm gãm urvarãm
perene âhitîm ýâ âiti âtrem
âpem zãm gãm urvarå.
segments.en:
'I drive away Aeshma, I drive away the Nasu, I drive away
direct defilement, I drive away indirect defilement.
['I drive away Khru, I drive away Khruighni.
'I drive away Buidhi, I drive away the offspring of Buidhi.
'I drive away Kundi, I drive away tle offspring of Kundi.]
'I drive away the gaunt Bushyasta, I drive away the long-handed
Bushyasta; [I drive away Muidhi,
I drive away Kapasti.]
'I drive away the Pairika that comes upon the fire, upon the
water, upon the earth, upon the cow, upon the tree. I drive away
the uncleanness that comes upon the fire, upon the water, upon
the earth, upon the cow, upon the tree.
segments.zh:
「我驅趕埃什瑪，我驅趕納蘇，我驅趕直接的不潔，我驅趕間接的不潔。
【我驅趕赫魯，我驅趕赫魯伊格尼。
我驅趕布伊迪，我驅趕布伊迪的後代。
我驅趕昆迪，我驅趕昆迪的後代。】
我驅趕憔悴的布什亞斯塔，我驅趕長臂的布什亞斯塔；【我驅趕穆伊迪，我驅趕卡帕斯提。】
我驅趕降臨於火焰的派里卡，降臨於水的派里卡，降臨於土地的派里卡，降臨於牛的派里卡，降臨於樹木的派里卡。我驅趕降臨於火焰的不潔，降臨於水的不潔，降臨於土地的不潔，降臨於牛的不潔，降臨於樹木的不潔。」

segments.orig:
perene thwâ duzhda angra mainyô haca nmânat
haca âthrat haca apat haca zemat haca gaot haca urvarayât
haca narem ashavanem haca nâirikãm ashaonîm
haca strêsh haca månghem haca hvare haca anakhra raocå
haca vîspa vohu mazdadhâta ashacithra.
segments.en:
'I drive thee away, O mischievous Angra Mainyu! from the fire,
from the water, from the earth, from the cow, from the tree, from
the faithful man and from the faithful woman, from the stars,
from the moon, from the sun, from the boundless light, from all
good things, made by Mazda, the offspring of the holy principle.
segments.zh: 「我驅趕你，淘氣的安格拉‧曼紐啊！遠離火焰，遠離水，遠離土地，遠離牛，遠離樹木，遠離信仰的男人和信仰的女人，遠離星辰，遠離月亮，遠離太陽，遠離無邊的光明，遠離一切美善之物，由馬茲達所造，聖潔原則的後代。」

segments.orig:
atha imã vacô ... cathwârô ahuna
vairya frasrâvayôish, ýathâ ahû
vairyô...(4), kêm-nâ mazdâ ... ashahe.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt say these victorious, most healing words;
thou shalt chant four Ahuna-Vairyas :-
'"Yatha aha vairyo:- The will of the Lord is the law of righteousness,"
&c.
'" Kem-na mazda :- What protector
hast thou given unto me?" &c.
'"Ke verethrem-ja:- Who is the victorious?" &c.
'"Keep us from our hater, O Mazda!" &c.
segments.zh:
「然後你應當說出這些勝利的、最具治癒力的言詞；你應當吟誦四遍《阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞》：─
「『如主所願：─ 正義乃主之律』，
等等。
『堅握者馬茲達：─ 你給予我什麼守護者？』等等。
『誰是勝利者？─』等等。
『守護我們遠離我們的仇敵，馬茲達啊！』等等。」

segments.en:
'Aeshma is driven away; away the Nasu; away direct defilement,
away indirect defilement.
['Khru is driven away, away Khruighni; away Buidhi, away the offspring
of Buidhi; away Kundi, away the offspring of Kundi.]
'The gaunt Bushyasta is driven away; away Bushyasta, the long-handed;
[away Muidhi, away Kapasti.]
'The Pairika is driven away that comes upon the fire, upon the
water, upon the earth, upon the cow, upon the tree. The uncleanness
is driven away that comes upon the fire, upon the water, upon
the earth, upon the cow, upon the tree.
segments.zh:
「埃什瑪已被驅趕去；納蘇已被驅趕去；直接的不潔已被驅趕去，間接的不潔已被驅趕去。
【赫魯已被驅趕去，赫魯伊格尼已被驅趕去；布伊迪已被驅趕去，布伊迪的後代已被驅趕去；昆迪已被驅趕去，昆迪的後代已被驅趕去。】
憔悴的布什亞斯塔已被驅趕去；長臂的布什亞斯塔已被驅趕去；【穆伊迪已被驅趕去，卡帕斯提已被驅趕去。】
降臨於火焰的派里卡已被驅趕去，降臨於水的派里卡已被驅趕去，降臨於土地的派里卡已被驅趕去，降臨於牛的派里卡已被驅趕去，降臨於樹木的派里卡已被驅趕去。降臨於火焰的不潔已被驅趕去，降臨於水的不潔已被驅趕去，降臨於土地的不潔已被驅趕去，降臨於牛的不潔已被驅趕去，降臨於樹木的不潔已被驅趕去。」

haca narem ashavanem haca nâirikãm ashaonîm

segments.en:
'Thou art driven away, O mischievous Angra Mainyu! from the
fire, from the water, from the earth, from the cow, from the tree,
from the faithful man and from the faithful woman, from the stars,
from the moon, from the sun, from the boundless light, from all
good things, made by Mazda, the offspring of the holy principle.
segments.zh: 「你已被驅趕去，淘氣的安格拉‧曼紐啊！遠離火焰，遠離水，遠離土地，遠離牛，遠離樹木，遠離信仰的男人和信仰的女人，遠離星辰，遠離月亮，遠離太陽，遠離無邊的光明，遠離一切美善之物，由馬茲達所造，聖潔原則的後代。」

segments.orig:
atha imã vacô ... cathwârô mazdâ
at môi frasrâvayôish, mazdâ at môi...(4).
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt say these victorious, most healing words;
thou shalt chant "Mazda ad moi" four times: "O
Mazda! say unto me the excellent words and the excellent works,
that through the good thought and the holiness of him who offers
thee the due meed of praise, thou mayest, O Lord! make the world
of Resurrection appear, at thy will, under thy sovereign rule."
segments.zh: 「然後你應當說出這些勝利的、最具治癒力的言詞；你應當吟誦『馬茲達與我』四遍：『馬茲達啊！向我說出卓越的言詞和卓越的行為，使得通過獻祭者的善念和聖潔，你啊，主啊！可能使復活之世顯現，以你的意願，在你的主權統治之下。』」

segments.en:
'I drive away Aeshma, I drive away the Nasu,' &c.
'I drive thee away, O mischievous Angra Mainyu! from the fire,
from the water,' &c.
segments.zh:
「『我驅趕埃什瑪，我驅趕納蘇，』等等。
『我驅趕你，淘氣的安格拉‧曼紐啊！遠離火焰，遠離水，』等等。」

segments.orig:
atha imã vacô ... pañca ahuna vairya frasrâvayôish,
ýathâ ahû vairyô...(5), kêm-nâ
mazdâ ... ashahe! ashem vohû...!!
segments.zh: 「然後你應當說出這些勝利的、最具治癒力的言詞；你應當吟誦《艾里亞瑪‧伊什約》四遍：『願履行誓約的艾里亞曼來臨此處！』等等。」

segments.en: 'Aeshma is driven away; away the Nasu,' &c.
segments.zh: 「埃什瑪被驅走；納蘇被驅走」等等。

segments.en:
'Thou art driven away, O mischievous Angra Mainyu! from the
fire, from the water,' &c.
segments.zh: 「你被驅走了，惡劣的安格拉‧曼紐啊！遠離火焰，遠離水」等等。

segments.en:
'Then thou shalt say these victorious, most healing words;
thou shalt chant five Ahuna-Vairyas:-
'"Yatha ahu vairyo:- The will of the Lord is the law of righteousness,"
&c.
'"Kem-na mazda:- Whom hast thou placed to protect me?"
&c.
'"Ke verethrem-ja:- Who is he who will smite the fiend?"
&c.
'"Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Armaiti Spenta! Perish,
O fiendish Druj! Perish, O brood of the fiend! Perish, O world
of the fiend! Perish away, O Druj! Rush away, O Druj! Perish away,
O Druj! Perish away to the regions of the north, never more to
give unto death the living world of Righteousness!"'
segments.zh: 「那時你應說這些勝利的、最治癒的言語；你應誦唱五次阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞：——『雅特‧阿胡‧瓦伊里約：主的旨意乃是正義之法』等等。『肯—那‧馬茲達：你置立誰來保護我？』等等。『肯‧維雷思雷姆—賈：誰是他，將要擊殺惡魔？』等等。『守護我們免於我們的仇恨者，啊馬茲達與聖者阿爾邁提！惡德魯格啊，滅亡吧！惡魔之嗣啊，滅亡吧！惡魔之世界啊，滅亡吧！德魯格啊，滅亡遠去！德魯格啊，急速遠去！德魯格啊，滅亡遠去！德魯格啊，滅亡往北方之域，永不再將死亡賜予正義之活世界！』」
